strongest_angle: The collapse of 777 Partners followed a massive $500 million fraud scheme orchestrated by co-founder Josh Wander, who misled lenders and investors before pleading guilty in a Manhattan federal court.

key_facts.fact: Josh Wander, the 45-year-old co-founder of Miami-based investment firm 777 Partners, pleaded guilty to wire fraud and securities fraud in a Manhattan federal court.
Federal prosecutors in the Southern District of New York stated that the scheme to bilk lenders and investors out of at least $500 million led to the collapse of 777 Partners.
As part of the plea agreement, Josh Wander has agreed to pay back $500 million in losses caused by the financial deception scheme.
